overall_summary: Data sample is extremely small with low views across all initial uploads, making it hard to identify definitive viral winners. However, slightly higher traction is observed on specific relationship and memory-based hooks, while generic or late-night abstract hooks underperformed.

winning_patterns.evidence: A_eLARoegnw ('आज भी फोन में...') and a9-G1X5jEOU got slightly better relative views (12-15 views) compared to abstract time hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate tangible everyday communication remnants (like saved chats or contact names) into future hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: G0gKV1p3ZHc ('रात के दो बजे') and uIbMpCjVutQ ('मेज पर रखी चाय') received the lowest engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting purely with time or objects; anchor the hook immediately to human actions and modern digital realities.
